product.name: Wireless Headphones
product.tagline: Premium sound for a more connected world.

_notes.fields: Renderer prints fields[] as given. No universal schema in the UI. Pharma sends Dosage Form / Strength / Expiry; lubricant sends Viscosity / Volume / OEM approvals.
_notes.sections: Only render sections present. Known ids: product-details, specifications, ingredients, certifications, warranty, safety, regulatory, sustainability, supply-chain, provenance, documents, patient-information, recall, brand.
_notes.promo: Brand-supplied. Mobile only. Desktop shows the platform story block.
_notes.status: One of the keys in _states. Drives status component modifier, icon, headline, message, primary action, and which body layout renders (product vs guidance).

loading.headline: Checking your product…
loading.message: Please wait while we verify your product using GS1 standards.

verified.headline: Product Verified
verified.message: This product identity has been successfully verified using GS1 standards.

not-found.headline: Product Not Found
not-found.message: We couldn't find product information for this code. It may be unregistered or incorrect.

invalid.headline: Invalid Code
invalid.message: The QR code or link is not valid. Please check the code and try again.

unable.headline: Unable to Verify
unable.message: We found product information but we are unable to complete verification at this time. Please try again later.

alert.headline: Verification Alert
alert.message: This product identifier has unusual scan activity and may not be genuine.

duplicate.headline: Code Scanned Before
duplicate.message: This product code has already been scanned. First scanned on {firstScanAt}.

recalled.headline: Product Recall
recalled.message: This product is subject to a recall. Please do not use this product.

expired.headline: Product Expired
expired.message: This product has passed its use-by date. For your safety, please do not use this product.

unavailable.headline: Service Unavailable
unavailable.message: We're unable to verify products at the moment. Please try again later.
